To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: console + API walkthrough & preflight access

Hi Tessa,

We'd like to schedule a 60-minute session next week to walk through the Redwood Console and get API keys for a sandbox environment. Attendees: me, our infra lead (Tom), and an ML engineer. Goal is a short run-through of:
- Console routing and model pinning
- API key provisioning and basic request examples
- Quick sanity checks for latency and cost dashboards

We can be flexible but prefer US morning slots (9–11am PT) on Tue/Wed/Thu (Oct 5–7). Also attached our preflight checklist. Can you confirm what your team needs ahead of time (access, DNS allowlist, service account)?

Thanks,
Emma Barnes
Director of Integrations, FinLytics

(415) 555-0192

Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 12:05:00 -0700

Hi Emma — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the checklist, looks straightforward.

Proposed 60-min slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 5, 9:30–10:30am
- Wed Oct 6, 10:00–11:00am
- Thu Oct 7, 9:00–10:00am

We should cover console nav, service-account based API keys, a short live request demo, and a walk through of the cost/latency dashboard and KV caching tips. Prep we need from you before the session:
- Names and emails for the accounts that need sandbox access (we'll pre-provision service accounts)
- A single sample prompt/endpoint you plan to test so we can replicate token counts
- Any IPs to allowlist (if you want to test from your infra)

Ben will run the live demo; Marissa will handle environment provisioning. If any of the proposed times work pick one and we'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
